MCSettings.Name: EL Model Element Checks V02
MCSettings.Author: DAR BIM Unit
MCSettings.Description: Electrical model element checks: model health, spaces, worksets by category, link worksets and views

Section.Description: This is a high priority test. Make sure that no CAD links or imports exist in the file.

Check.Description: Will report a list of linked CAD files in the model.
Check.FailureMessage: Linked CAD files found in the model — review and remove if not required.

Section.Description: This is a high priority test. Make sure that all critical warnings are resolved.

Check.Description: Reports all warnings in a Revit model.
Check.FailureMessage: Model contains warnings — review and resolve.

Section.Description: This is a high priority test. Make sure that all links are pinned.

Check.Description: Will report any links that are not pinned in place.
Check.FailureMessage: Not all links are pinned in place.

Section.Description: This is a medium priority test. Make sure you solve all the crictical cases.

Check.Description: Fixture elevation should be checked
Check.FailureMessage: Check electrical fixture elevation and workplane height,location

Section.Description: This is a low priority test. Make sure you solve all the cases that affect the design and presentation.

Check.Description: Check non hosted electrical elements
Check.FailureMessage: Elements are not associated to host, please check

Check.Description: Check non hosted electrical elements
Check.FailureMessage: orphaned elements, pick new host

Heading.Description: This is a high priority test. Make sure that there are no duplicate spaces, no unplaced or redundant rooms and that spaces names match room names.

Check.CheckName: Spaces with NO Duplicated Space Number
Check.Description: Checks for Space Duplicated Space Number
Check.FailureMessage: Some spaces have duplicate numbers. Check space Schedule to delete duplicated spaces

Check.CheckName: Spaces are consistent with No Unplaced or Redundant spaces
Check.Description: Checks for spaces that are "not placed", "not enclosed", or "redundant" in the model.
Check.FailureMessage: Some spaces are "not placed", "not enclosed", or "redundant" . Check Space Schedule

Check.Description: space refers to unoccupied
Check.FailureMessage: Space doesn't refer to valid room element, check link or remove

Check.Description: Space name should match room name
Check.FailureMessage: Check space names and run space naming utility
